notes: Reviewed effective specifications for the nine Gevrey-Chambertin Grand Cru AOCs. July 2026 national-opposition procedures are pending and are not treated as current law. Accessory Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris are omitted from ordinary blend authorization because the effective rules confine them to mixed plantings within parcels.
